subject.title: feat(telegram): handle unknown groups with warn or leave

question: Should OpenClaw accept an opt-in Telegram unknown-group action config that can warn and leave non-allowlisted groups, and should this PR be revised into that contract?
rationale: The PR adds new user-facing config plus a security-sensitive Telegram leaveChat side effect, so automation can identify implementation defects but cannot choose the permanent product/security semantics.

options.title: Revise This PR Into The Contract
options.body: Keep the direction but require precise unknown-group classification, native-command parity, topic-safe warning sends, docs/config metadata, and live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Decline The New Config Surface
options.body: Keep current fail-closed allowlist behavior and document that unapproved groups are dropped or blocked without warning or auto-leave.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Group Admission
options.body: Defer warn/leave behavior until the broader group-pairing and owner-notification design settles cross-channel authorization semantics.

recommendation.title: Revise This PR Into The Contract
recommendation.body: Keep the direction but require precise unknown-group classification, native-command parity, topic-safe warning sends, docs/config metadata, and live Telegram proof before merge.
